description:
Motion graphics and visual effects; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects, rebuilt in pure Rust

Motion graphics and visual effects; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects, rebuilt in pure Rust.
EffectCraft is young: its first commit was on 1 October 2026. Nearly every After Effects feature exists, including all of its effects, but existing is not the same as behaving exactly like After Effects. Today it's a good place to try things and to tell us what breaks.
After Effects projects can't be opened. Projects are saved as .ecproj, readable versioned JSON, but EffectCraft can't open .aep / .aepx files, and After Effects plug-ins don't run.
Note
FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release. We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.
What's Changed
- security: use crypto.randomUUID for temp file suffix (SonarCloud S2245) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2061
- fix: JS reliability bugs (SonarCloud S1764/S9383/S4275) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2062
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0
